spine: 1. RSA-250 是上一個公開紀錄（2020 年 2 月），之後六年沒人打破；RSA-260 公告前幾天，社群已注意到多組人馬同時在衝刺，包括 Steve Weis 問 Anthropic 要來兩週、1024 顆 GPU（約 39 GPU-year）但被別人先完成。Eric Lu 自陳這是 job scheduler 優化的概念驗證加上十年興趣，且在此之前已拆過 C311，明知線性代數尚未優化就賭 RSA-260 一個月內可完成，跳過了穩健的中繼步驟。
2. 賽前用標準 GNFS scaling law 粗估的成本（RSA-250 已知 2,700 core-year、RSA-260 估 3,400–4,100 core-year，GPU 加速後估 25 GPU-year）是這場競賽的公共基準線，多組人拿它去申請算力。
3. Cognition 的 Eric Lu 用一套大幅改寫過的 CADO-NFS，把 GNFS 三段管線（多項式選擇、格篩、線性系統求解）中最耗算力的格篩段搬上 GPU（glas，GPU 版 las），三段分別是 643 / 3,813 / 467 GPU-day，總計約 4,900 GPU-day（13.5 GPU-year）——比賽前最樂觀的 25 GPU-year 估計還低將近一半。
4. 這套優化與整條 cluster 的排程操作，主要由 Devin agent 自主完成（233 個 session、14,450 ACU，其中 192 個 session 裡他親自傳了 82,702 字、3,328 則訊息），Eric Lu 的角色是設優先序、抓基準、抓「跑偏了」的訊號。
5. 換算市價（$0.08/CPU core-hour、$3.50/GPU-hour），這次跑約花 $400k，比先前公開已知最好的 GNFS 實作便宜 10 倍（文章未點名對照對象）。
6. 用同一套標準 GNFS scaling law 外插，RSA-1024（309 位數）只比 RSA-260 多需要 78 倍算力，Eric Lu 估計市價約 $30M 可以完成，並明白承認現在的實作還遠不是最優，再省一半也不奇怪。
7. RSA-2048 仍比 RSA-1024 難上十億倍，這次工程進展「不影響」它的安全性；但 1024-bit RSA 早在 2013 年就該淘汰，如果系統裡還留著，問題不是「會不會被破解」，而是「為什麼還沒換掉」。

perspective.mechanism: GNFS 分三段序列執行——多項式選擇定義數體、格篩在 GF(2) 上產生大量稀疏線性關係、線性系統求解把關係打包成矩陣找出線性相依；三段的計算量分布（643/3,813/467 GPU-day）顯示格篩吃掉了絕大部分算力，是移植到 GPU（glas）最有價值的一段。
perspective.tradeoff: 用 GPU 把格篩加速換來成本大降（10x），但作者自己承認實作「仍顯著次優」，且 4,900 GPU-day 裡有 643 GPU-day 的多項式選擇是「operator incompetence」造成的異常高耗，顯示成本曲線本身還有很大優化空間，不能把 $400k 當作 GNFS GPU 化的下限。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師該把 $30M-for-RSA-1024 這個估計當作會逐年下降的價格，而不是恐慌訊號——RSA-2048 仍差了十億倍，1024-bit 在 2013 年就該淘汰；系統裡若還留著 1024-bit key，問題不是「現在會不會被破解」而是「為什麼還沒換」。

perspective.mechanism: 這篇是 Eric Lu 部落格文章的中文轉述，補充了原文沒強調的觀察——GPU 版 GNFS 這個顯而易見的優化方向長期沒人做，直到 AI agent 時代才有人真的去實作，把「為什麼是現在」這個問題點出來。
perspective.tradeoff: 作為轉述文，大部分數字是對原文的複誦（echo），獨立價值有限；但幫助確認「台灣讀者圈子怎麼理解這則新聞」的視角，也連結回自己 9/8 的賽前預測文章。
perspective.reader_use: 讀者可以透過這篇確認中文轉述與原文數字一致，同時注意到「AI agent 能做困難工程優化」這個框架正在被更廣泛地報導、討論。

perspective.mechanism: 這篇早於 Cognition 公告兩天，記錄了 RSA-260 被解開後社群裡多組人馬同時衝刺的競賽狀態，並列出各方賽前用 GNFS scaling law 做的估算（RSA-250 的 2,700 core-year 基準、RSA-260 估 3,400–4,100 core-year、GPU 加速後估 25 GPU-year），還記下 Steve Weis 向 Anthropic 要到兩週 1024 GPU 資源卻被人先完成的細節。
perspective.tradeoff: 賽前估算（25 GPU-year）與 Cognition 事後公布的實際成本（13.5 GPU-year）有將近兩倍落差，說明賽前用標準 scaling law 粗估的成本，跟真正把格篩搬上 GPU、跑通整套 pipeline 後的實際成本，中間還隔著大量工程優化空間。
perspective.reader_use: 讀者可以用這篇反推「賽前估算」與「賽後實測」的落差有多大，理解為什麼算力成本估算容易被工程實作細節打臉，也看到 Steve Weis／Anthropic 這樣的資源投入卻被別人先完成的競速細節。

notes.quote: RSA-260 was factored by a new implementation of the general number field sieve (GNFS) for GPUs
notes.interpretation: 作者直接宣稱這次用的是一套新的 GPU 版 GNFS 實作，不是既有 CPU 實作的簡單搬移。

notes.quote: The implementation was a significantly modified CADO-NFS
notes.interpretation: 底層基礎是學界既有的 CADO-NFS，但做了大量改寫，不是原封不動使用。

notes.quote: we adapted CADO's stage-1 polynomial selection to GPUs (resulting in `gps1`), using also some kernel equipment from msieve's well-optimized stage-1 polynomial selection.
notes.interpretation: 多項式選擇這段也被搬上 GPU（gps1），且借用了 msieve 既有的優化核心，不是憑空重寫。

notes.quote: Polynomial selection fixes the number field over which the algorithm is run. The choice of polynomial controls a constant-factor speedup on the lattice sieving step.
notes.interpretation: 多項式選擇的功能定位：決定數體，並間接影響格篩效率。

notes.quote: The goal of lattice sieving is to produce lots (8.3 billion in our case) of sparse linear relations over GF(2), where here (suppressing some details) the vector entries represent the parities of prime exponents in the prime factorization of a smooth number.
notes.interpretation: 格篩段的具體產出目標：83 億條 GF(2) 上的稀疏線性關係。

notes.quote: Ultimately, we pack these relations into a large matrix over GF(2) and use linear system solving to find a linear dependence.
notes.interpretation: 線性系統求解段把前段產出的關係組成矩陣求解，找出可用來拆因數的線性相依。

notes.quote: In total, I estimate that this factorization cost about 4,900 GPU-days, or 13.5 GPU-years, which is about $400k at current market prices. In more detail, modern GNFS implementations consist of a few stages run sequentially: polynomial selection, lattice sieving, and linear system solving.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己的總成本估計，用「I estimate」明確標記為估算而非精確核算。

notes.quote: 643 GPU-days in polynomial selection (this is anomalously high basically due to operator incompetence)
notes.interpretation: 多項式選擇段實際花費，作者自陳這個數字異常偏高，原因是操作失誤。

notes.quote: 3,813 GPU-days sieving
notes.interpretation: 格篩段實際花費的 GPU-day 數，是三段裡最大的一段。

notes.quote: 467 GPU-days linear system solving (of which about 7% failed to make progress due to crashes or preemption by more important work)
notes.interpretation: 線性系統求解段的花費與其中因當機／搶佔而無效的比例。

notes.quote: Costs assume $0.08/CPU core-hour, $3.50/GPU-hour.
notes.interpretation: appendix 給的成本換算假設，是把 GPU-day 換算成美元的依據。

notes.quote: which enables factoring numbers at 10x lower cost than the previous public state of the art. Here is the factorization:
notes.interpretation: 作者宣稱這次方法比先前公開已知最佳的 GPU GNFS 實作便宜十倍，未具名指出對照對象是誰。

notes.quote: Polynomial selection began on 2026-08-18 at 12:14:19 UTC
notes.interpretation: 多項式選擇段的起始時間戳。

notes.quote: Sieving began on 2026-08-22 at 10:01:12 UTC and reached target at 2026-08-30 07:26:15 UTC
notes.interpretation: 格篩段的起訖時間戳。

notes.quote: Linear algebra began on 2026-08-30 15:45:10 UTC...Factors were produced at 2026-09-03 01:48:57 UTC
notes.interpretation: 線性代數段起始與最終出解的時間戳。

notes.quote: My role was primarily to set priorities, establish benchmarks, and recognize when work was going off-track. Devin otherwise autonomously handled measurements, cluster operations, and optimization end-to-end
notes.interpretation: 作者自述自己在整個工程裡的角色，以及 Devin 自主處理的範圍。

notes.quote: I cannot claim that Devin iterated autonomously on the entire end-to-end pipeline
notes.interpretation: 作者明確保留：不能宣稱 Devin 完全自主完成整條 pipeline，避免誇大自主程度。

notes.quote: In retrospect, Devin claims that I sent 82,702 words (502,887 characters) in 3,328 messages across 192 sessions out of 233 used for factoring (totaling 14,450 ACUs).
notes.interpretation: 作者引用 Devin 自己回報的對話量與 session／ACU 統計，本身帶有「Devin claims」的轉述保留。

notes.quote: I did this as a side project using a single-digit percentage of our cluster, in the course of optimizing our job scheduler to improve allocations to use disaggregated compute.
notes.interpretation: 作者說明這是側寫專案，只用了 cluster 個位數百分比的算力，並非全公司資源投入。

notes.quote: las.threads 22
notes.interpretation: appendix 設定值：格篩每個節點的平行執行緒數設為 22，是調校過的參數。

notes.quote: According to standard GNFS scaling this is merely 78x more computation than RSA-260. I estimate the cost of factoring RSA-1024 at market GPU prices to be roughly $30M, which can trade off against wall clock time.
notes.interpretation: 作者用標準 GNFS scaling law 外插 RSA-1024 所需算力倍數，並給出市價估算，兩者都用「merely」「I estimate」「roughly」標記為推算而非精確值。

notes.quote: I know for a fact that the current implementation remains significantly suboptimal; I would not be surprised if moderate further work could reduce the cost of factoring RSA-1024 by another multiple of 2
notes.interpretation: 作者明白承認目前實作還有優化空間，未來成本可能再腰斬，但用「would not be surprised」保留而非斷言。

notes.quote: On the other hand, RSA-2048 remains roughly a billion times harder than RSA-1024 and does not appear to be meaningfully affected by this work.
notes.interpretation: 作者評估 RSA-2048 的安全性未受這次工作實質影響，用「roughly」「does not appear to」保留精確度。

notes.quote: state-of-the-art RSA public keys contain 2048 bit (~617 digit) factoring problems, while 1024-bit (~309 digit) RSA was deprecated in 2013
notes.interpretation: 作者陳述的背景事實：現行 RSA 公鑰是 2048-bit，1024-bit 已在 2013 年被淘汰。

notes.quote: The previous record, RSA-250, was set in February 2020.
notes.interpretation: 上一個公開 RSA challenge 紀錄的時間點。

notes.quote: In conclusion, the barrier to entry for cryptanalytic work, other computational mathematics more broadly, and likely most large-scale scientific computing research, is far lower than it used to be.
notes.interpretation: 作者的結論性主張：這類工作的門檻已大幅降低，範圍不只密碼分析、也及於計算數學與大規模科學計算研究。

notes.quote: This substituted for what would likely have been a multi-month effort by a team of highly specialized domain experts
notes.interpretation: 作者用「would likely have been」推測：若走傳統路線，這是一個專業團隊要花數月的工程。

notes.quote: At August 13th 0:11:58 Pacific time I aimed Devin at producing a drop-in replacement for las
notes.interpretation: 作者標記把任務交給 Devin 的確切起始時間，目標是做出 las 的一比一替代品。

notes.quote: Then I went to bed. I woke up to find that, after another 7 hours of iteration, Devin had succeeded. Over the subsequent week I drove Devin to optimize lattice sieving, then the rest of the GNFS pipeline.
notes.interpretation: 作者描述 glas 初版成形的具體場景：睡前交給 Devin，7 小時迭代後成功，接下來一週持續優化。

notes.quote: 已知 RSA-250 (829 bits) 用了 2700 core-year
notes.interpretation: gslin 引用的既有歷史數字，作為賽前估算的基準。

notes.quote: 現在估算 RSA-260 (862 bits) 大約會是 3400～4100 core-year
notes.interpretation: gslin 用標準 scaling law 對 RSA-260 做的粗估區間，明確標記「估算」。

notes.quote: 結果大家都得到用 GPU 加速的答案，估算可以大幅降到 25 GPU-year
notes.interpretation: 社群賽前收斂出的 GPU 加速後估算值，同樣標記為估算。

notes.quote: 前幾天提到的「RSA-260 被解開」後來在 social network 上面看到一些討論，包括也有其他競爭對手也進入到最後階段
notes.interpretation: gslin 記錄的社群觀察：不只一組人在衝刺 RSA-260。

notes.quote: Steve Weis 問了 Anthropic，得到了兩個禮拜 1024 GPU 的資源開幹，如果跑滿的話大約是 39 GPU-year，不過就被其他人先完成了。
notes.interpretation: Steve Weis 拿到的算力配置與換算 GPU-year（「如果跑滿的話」為條件式估算），以及他最終被人先完成的結果。

notes.quote: 另外他也提到 RSA-1024 (1024 bits) 估算大約是 2000 GPU-year
notes.interpretation: 賽前（Cognition 公告前）社群對 RSA-1024 所需算力的粗估，同樣標記為估算，且早於 Cognition 給出的 $30M／78x 估算。

notes.quote: 比較好奇的反而是 GPU 版本的 GNFS 一直都沒人 porting，直到 AI 時代才有人跳進去
notes.interpretation: gslin 轉述 Cognition 文章後自己的觀察：GPU 版 GNFS 技術上早可行，真正的變數是「有沒有人願意做」。

notes.quote: Ultimately, we pack these relations into a large matrix over GF(2) and use linear system solving to find a linear dependence. At this scale, linear system solving is typically distributed and requires a lot of communication bandwidth; this is available in spades over Infiniband and NVLink.
notes.interpretation: 線性系統求解在這個規模下需要靠分散式運算，通訊頻寬需求很大，靠 Infiniband／NVLink 提供。

notes.quote: The block Wiedemann algorithm permits relaxing the communication constraint somewhat, and the particular implementation in CADO-NFS is also susceptible to optimization and running on GPUs, which we undertook.
notes.interpretation: 點名線性代數段使用的具體演算法：block Wiedemann，並說明選它的原因是能放寬通訊限制、且 CADO-NFS 裡的實作本身可優化並搬上 GPU。

notes.quote: Lattice sieving is also embarrassingly parallel over work items called "special q"s, but each work item requires performing a large number of read/writes at (for our purposes) pseudorandom locations in a large array; handling this was the primary technical challenge in optimizing sieving.
notes.interpretation: 解釋格篩為何難搬上 GPU 的具體機制：以 special q 為單位天生高度平行，但每個工作項目需要大量偽隨機位置的陣列讀寫，這個存取型態才是優化的核心難題。

notes.quote: I initially intended the linear algebra configuration to be m = n = 512 and two width-256 sequences on 16 GB200 nodes in a 4x4 MPI grid (64 GPUs each). I had planned on using dedicated cliques, but could not due to the requirements of higher-priority workloads, so proceeded with scattered compute as before.
notes.interpretation: 線性代數段原本規劃的具體硬體配置（16 個 GB200 節點、4x4 MPI 網格、64 GPU）與理想的 dedicated cliques 網路拓樸；因更高優先序工作而改用散落算力。

notes.quote: However, all prior public GNFS factorization records used only CPUs for lattice sieving; indeed, due to challenges of efficiently implementing lattice sieving on GPUs, for a long time it was not clear that GPU lattice sieving could be more cost-effective overall.
notes.interpretation: 說明歷史背景：在這次之前，所有公開的 GNFS 分解紀錄格篩都只用 CPU，因為 GPU 格篩的效率實作長期以來划不划算並不明朗。
RSA-260 最終拆出的兩個質因數，各在原始輸出裡標為 p130，即各為 130 位數。

notes.quote: Somehow, the answer seems to be: still a lot.
notes.interpretation: 作者對「儘管 Devin 高度自主，人力介入還剩多少」這個隱含問題的自我回答：不知為何，答案似乎還是很多。

notes.quote: I found Devin's ability to generalize here quite impressive.
notes.interpretation: 作者對 Devin 把原本 ML／GPU 相關的技能類推到數論計算這個不同領域的正面評價。

notes.quote: at no marginal cost on spare or fragmented compute
notes.interpretation: 這次分解花的是閒置或零碎算力，沒有額外邊際成本，呼應「個位數百分比 cluster」的側寫專案定位。

notes.quote: Over the past few weeks, the Cognition research team and I have been optimizing our job scheduler to better use disaggregated compute.
notes.interpretation: 文章開頭交代這個專案的起點：本來是在優化 job scheduler、善用 disaggregated compute 的過程中順手做的。

notes.quote: RSA-260 (a 260 digit number) sets a new record for the largest publicly solved RSA Factoring Challenge problem, which benchmarks the feasibility of breaking the RSA cryptosystem.
notes.interpretation: 開頭定義 RSA-260 屬於 RSA Factoring Challenge，這個系列合成數的用途是量測拆解 RSA 的實際可行性。

notes.quote: As a proof of concept, and because I've enjoyed factoring numbers as a hobby for the past ten years or so, I drove a bevy of Devins to obtain a factorization of RSA-260.
notes.interpretation: 作者交代動機：這是 job scheduler 優化的概念驗證，加上他十年來的個人興趣；且用詞是複數「a bevy of Devins」，不是單一 Devin instance。

notes.quote: After factoring the C311 (which was roughly equivalent in difficulty to GNFS on a 216-digit number), it would have been safer to proceed by factoring a 230-digit equivalent difficulty number in order to cross the remaining couple of orders of magnitude. But I estimated that RSA-260 could be done in under a month and therefore had already begun polynomial selection, even though I knew the linear algebra remained significantly underoptimized.
notes.interpretation: 作者交代先前拆過 C311（約 216 位數等效難度），照穩健邏輯該先挑 230 位數等級的中繼目標，但他自估 RSA-260 一個月內可完成，於是跳過中繼步驟直接開始，即使明知線性代數段還沒優化好。

notes.quote: The only untouched programs in the CADO-NFS pipeline were: `cado-nfs.py` itself, `polyselect_ropt` (stage-2 polynomial selection), `makefb`, and `dup1`. We even had to optimize `fake_rels` to get reasonable performance for synthetic inputs of the needed sizes.
notes.interpretation: 量化「大幅改寫」的程度：整條 CADO-NFS pipeline 裡只有四支程式沒被動過，連測試資料產生工具 fake_rels 都得重新優化。

notes.quote: which enables factoring numbers at 10x lower cost than the previous public state of the art
notes.interpretation: 「10x 便宜」宣稱沒有點名具體的對照對象是誰；WebFetch 覆核也確認文中沒有明確指名先前的 GPU 實作，只提到 RSA-250（CPU 格篩，2020 年）作為時間參照，不是嚴格同代 GPU 對照。

notes.quote: state-of-the-art RSA public keys contain 2048 bit (~617 digit) factoring problems
notes.interpretation: RSA-2048 換算十進位約 617 位數，是 RSA-1024（309 位數）的兩倍位數；用來說明「十億倍」量級差距源自 GNFS 次指數複雜度公式而非任意誇飾。

notes.quote: grids 4x2, 4x4, 8x4 and 16x4 of GB300 and GB200 nodes
notes.interpretation: appendix 設定表顯示線性代數等步驟實際用了多種網格規模，機型橫跨 GB300 與 GB200，不是單一固定配置。

notes.quote: thr=2x4, no MPI, one B200 node; mm_impl=cuda
notes.interpretation: 更正（Step 7.6c）：appendix 設定表裡「one B200 node」出現在 C155/C157/C173/C175 這些較小暖身分解的 linear algebra: krylov 欄位下，不是 RSA-260、也不是格篩段。先前把它讀成「格篩等步驟用單顆 B200 節點」是誤讀，該句已從文中刪除。

notes.quote: I think we should not shy away from this exploration. In particular, if a problem can be solved via 'just programming', it seems worthwhile to attempt this immediately.
notes.interpretation: 作者在正式結論前的態度陳述：不該迴避這類探索，特別是能靠寫程式解決的問題值得立刻嘗試。

notes.quote: Thanks to Alex Lombardi for mathematical consultation and much editing. Thanks to my employer Cognition...
notes.interpretation: 文末致謝：Alex Lombardi 提供數學諮詢與大量編修，說明關鍵數學判斷仍有人類專家把關，不是純粹 Devin 自主產出。

notes.quote: By Eric Lu09.09.26
notes.interpretation: 文章署名與發布日期：作者是 Eric Lu，發布日為 2026 年 9 月 9 日，不是 9 月 10 日（9/10 是 gslin 轉述文章的發布日，先前誤植到 Cognition 原文上）。這則署名也是文中約 15 處把引語歸給「Eric Lu」具名的依據。

notes.quote: A GPU-optimized lattice siever based on `las`

notes.quote: I report essentially no algorithmic advancements — implementing lattice sieving and sparse linear system solving on GPUs required only 'good old performance engineering.'
notes.interpretation: 作者自陳格篩與線性系統求解搬上 GPU 沒有演算法層面的創新，靠的是效能工程，進一步佐證 glas 不是「從頭發明」的產物。

notes.quote: GNFS is the most efficient algorithm known for (most) numbers above roughly 100 digits in size.
notes.interpretation: GNFS 效率宣稱帶有兩個限定：「大多數」數字、「約 100 位數以上」，不是無條件的「已知最快的通用方法」。

notes.quote: was used in previous record-breaking RSA number factorizations
notes.interpretation: GNFS 過去用於打破 RSA 分解紀錄，但文章沒有給「三十年」這個時間跨度的說法。
